response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_dur) AS avg_of_avg_rental_duration, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_rate_to_cost_ratio FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_dur, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY rating) t

assumptions.assumption: Ratio is computed per film as rental_rate / replacement_cost (using decimal division), averaged within each rating, then the per-rating averages are averaged with equal weight per rating (not weighted by film count).
Films with NULL rating form their own group if any exist; the verified data shows 5 rating levels, so this likely has no effect.
